title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 210 (Termination of sub-agent’s authority)

content.overview: The termination of the authority of an agent causes the termination (subject to the rules herein contained regarding the termination of an agent’s authority) of the authority of all sub-agents appointed by him.
content.glance: Termination of agent’s authority terminates authority of sub-agents appointed by him (subject to Chapter X termination rules).
content.study: The termination of the authority of an agent causes the termination (subject to the rules herein contained regarding the termination of an agent’s authority) of the authority of all sub-agents appointed by him.

sections.heading: Effect on sub-agents
sections.body: Authority of all sub-agents appointed by him terminates, subject to Chapter X termination rules.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 210 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Confirm termination of agent’s authority; apply automatic termination of sub-agents’ authority subject to Chapter X rules.

examTips: Sub-agent authority falls with agent’s authority.
